long_biography.plain_text:
Brisdane Consulting was constituted in Monaco in 2012 to provide technical studies, assistance and development for international projects. Its registered remit covers conventional fuels, new and clean energy, industrial operations and general engineering. Ahmed Stambouli was named manager and partner at incorporation, giving him both an operating role and an ownership interest from the company's outset.

That appointment followed his management of AS Consulting France, a Nice-based business-advisory firm. He also held a controlling interest in Mediterranean Energy Company, a British financial-management business. These roles place his business activity across Monaco, France and the United Kingdom, and across consulting, financial management and commercial representation.
